web_commons.name: test_account_existing_user_profile
web_commons.title: Profile: Existing user can view their My Profile details
web_commons.docstring: 1. Sign in as an existing user 2. Navigate to the Account page 3. Open My Profile 4. Verify the first name, last name and email on the My Profile page

web_commons.name: test_account_delivery_addresses
web_commons.title: Profile: Existing user can view their saved delivery addresses
web_commons.docstring: 1. Sign in as an existing user who already has a saved default address 2. Navigate to the Account page 3. Open Delivery Addresses 4. Verify a saved address is listed and exactly one is marked as the default

web_commons.name: test_account_add_new_address_and_set_default
web_commons.title: Profile: Existing user can add an address, make it default and delete the old one
web_commons.docstring: 1. Sign in as an existing user 2. Navigate to the Account page and open Delivery Addresses 3. Make sure the account already holds an address, so the set-as-default control renders 4. Click 'Add New Address' and fill the form for the configured country and locale 5. Mark the new address as the default and save it 6. Verify one more address is listed and exactly one is marked as the default 7. Delet

web_commons.name: test_account_invalid_login_combinations
web_commons.docstring: 1. Open the Sign In page as a guest user 2. Enter the parametrized email and password (blank values stay empty) 3. Submit without asserting the form closed 4. Assert the expected error - main banner and/or per-field message

web_commons.title: Categories: signed-in user loads every L1, L2 and L3 category level
web_commons.story: FALCONS-361 - Category levels L1, L2 and L3 load
web_commons.docstring: 1. Sign in, then open the Categories tab and verify the L1 categories load 2. Open the Toys L1 category and verify its L2 sub-categories load 3. Open 'Explore All' to land on the whole category listing 4. Walk every branch of its sub-category filter, descending a level at a time until the filter offers no more, then clearing the chips and starting the next branch 5. At every level verify the chips

web_commons.name: test_gift_registry_create_from_my_account
web_commons.story: FALCONS-339 - Create a gift registry from My Account
web_commons.docstring: Existing user creates a gift registry from My Account and finds it listed. 1. Sign in as an existing user for the current country 2. My Account -> Gift registry 3. Clear any registry left behind by an earlier run 4. Create a registry: pick an occasion, name it, submit 5. Verify the registry detail page 6. Go back to My Registries and verify the registry is listed

web_commons.story: FALCONS-340 - Create a gift registry from the PDP
web_commons.docstring: Guest hits Add to Registry, signs in, then builds one registry from the PDP. 1. Open the store and search the simple product 2. Open its PDP and click Add to Registry as a guest -> sign-in 3. Sign in and clear any registry left by an earlier run 4. Back on the same PDP, create the registry from the Add to Registry sheet 5. web_commons.name: test_gift_registry_purchase_shows_for_owner
web_commons.story: Gift Registry - the owner sees a guest's order under Purchased
web_commons.docstring: A guest buys from a published registry and the owner finds that order. 1. The owner builds a registry and publishes it 2. Capture the registry's share link 3. The owner signs back in, opens the registry and switches to Purchased 6. The buyer's order is listed there

web_commons.name: test_home_screen_elements_and_navigate_to_account
web_commons.title: Home: Explore screen shows key elements and navigates to Account
web_commons.docstring: 1. Go to the homepage as a guest user 2. Verify the search box and the bottom-navigation tabs render 3. Tap the Account tab in the bottom navigation 4. Verify the Account page is loaded

web_commons.name: test_home_search_product_in_specific_category
web_commons.title: Home: Customer can open a category listing from the search suggestions
web_commons.docstring: 1. Go to the homepage as a guest user 2. Type a keyword in the search box 3. Open the first category suggestion 4. Verify the category facet is applied on the listing and products render

web_commons.name: test_web_filters_one_filter_at_a_time
web_commons.title: mWeb filters: each of the most-used filters applies and clears on its own
web_commons.story: FALCONS-390 - One filter at a time
web_commons.docstring: 1. Open a search listing for the term under test 2. Tick Category, reading the product count printed beside the option, and confirm the sheet 3. Verify the filter is in the URL and the results total equals exactly that count 4. Clear it and verify the filter left the URL and the listing still shows products 5. Repeat for Brand, Age and Gender, each applied and cleared in isolation 6. Isolating eac

web_commons.name: test_web_filters_multiple_filters
web_commons.title: mWeb filters: stacking the offered filters keeps narrowing the listing
web_commons.docstring: 1. Open a search listing for the term under test 2. Stack Category, Brand, Gender and Age, committing the sheet after each one 3. Verify each writes its own query parameter and the total equals the count its option printed 4. Assert at least two actually stacked, so a facet the listing dropped cannot pass quietly

web_commons.name: test_web_filters_yalla_from_listing
web_commons.title: mWeb filters: Yalla applies from the listing itself
web_commons.docstring: 1. Open a search listing for the term under test and verify it loaded with products 2. Apply Yalla from the listing itself, outside the filter drawer 3. Verify the control reads as selected and the listing carries the Yalla parameter 4. Verify the page loaded, products are displayed and the results total narrowed 5. Verify every product displayed carries the Yalla delivery flag

web_commons.name: test_web_filters_price_range
web_commons.title: mWeb filters: the price slider narrows the listing and the prices respect it
web_commons.docstring: 1. Open the Deals listing, which offers the Price facet in every country and environment 2. Open the Filters drawer and expand the Price facet 3. Drag the upper handle down towards 250, read back the value it committed and confirm 4. Verify the page loaded, products are displayed and the results total narrowed 5. Verify every listed price falls under that ceiling

web_commons.name: test_web_filters_color_and_diaper_size
web_commons.title: mWeb filters: Color and Diaper Size each apply and clear on a category listing
web_commons.docstring: 1. Open the Diapers category listing, which offers both facets 2. Tick the first Color, confirm the sheet and verify the total equals the count it printed 3. Clear it and verify the filter left the URL and the listing still shows products 4. Repeat for Diaper Size

web_commons.name: test_web_filters_discounts
web_commons.title: mWeb filters: % Discounts narrows a category listing and clears again
web_commons.docstring: 1. Open the Diapers category listing, which offers the % Discounts toggle 2. Turn % Discounts on from the filter sheet and confirm the sheet 3. Verify the listing carries the discount parameter, narrowed, and still renders products 4. Verify every product displayed shows a struck-through was-price above the price paid 5. Turn it off and verify the parameter is gone and the listing still shows prod

web_commons.name: test_web_sort_by_price_from_both_entry_points
web_commons.title: mWeb sort: price sorting works from the listing control and the sticky one
web_commons.story: FALCONS-390 - Sort from both entry points
web_commons.docstring: 1. Open a search listing for the term under test 2. Sort by price low to high from the control at the top of the listing 3. Verify the rendered product prices ascend 4. Scroll down so the sticky control replaces it, and sort by price high to low 5. Verify the rendered product prices descend 6. Both controls open the same options, so each must sort and be verified from the prices

web_commons.name: test_wishlist_delete_all_product_types
web_commons.title: Wishlist: delete every product type using all three deletion options
web_commons.story: FALCONS-315 - Delete products from the wishlist
web_commons.docstring: 1. Sign in as an existing user and empty the wishlist 2. Add every product type to the wishlist from its PDP 3. Delete items one at a time with the per-item remove icon 4. Delete specific items via Select, verifying the unselected ones remain 5. Delete whatever is left via Select then Select All 6. Verify the wishlist shows its empty state

web_commons.name: test_wishlist_add_products_from_plps_existing_user
web_commons.title: Wishlist: existing user adds products to the wishlist from every PLP
web_commons.story: FALCONS-312 - Add products to the wishlist from PLPs
web_commons.docstring: 1. Sign in as an existing user and clear the wishlist 2. Add the first product to the wishlist from a Category listing 3. Add the first product from an SRP, once per product type 4. Add the first product from a Brand listing and from the Sale listing 5. Verify every product added is on the Wishlist page

web_commons.name: test_wishlist_add_products_from_plps_new_user
web_commons.title: Wishlist: new user adds products to the wishlist from every PLP
web_commons.story: FALCONS-312 - Add products to the wishlist from PLPs
web_commons.docstring: 1. Register a brand-new user, whose wishlist starts empty 2. Add the first product to the wishlist from a Category listing 3. Add the first product from an SRP, once per product type 4. Add the first product from a Brand listing and from the Sale listing 5. Verify every product added is on the Wishlist page

web_commons.name: test_wishlist_move_all_product_types_to_cart_existing_user
web_commons.title: Wishlist: existing user moves every product type from the wishlist to the cart
web_commons.story: FALCONS-316 - Move products from the wishlist to the cart
web_commons.docstring: 1. Sign in as an existing user, with the cart cleared through the API 2. Empty the wishlist, then add every product type to it from its PDP 3. Move each wishlist item to the cart, choosing a value when the options sheet opens 4. Verify every moved item leaves the wishlist and the cart holds one row per move 5. Verify the wishlist shows its empty state once the last item has moved 6. Empty the cart

web_commons.name: test_wishlist_move_all_product_types_to_cart_new_user
web_commons.title: Wishlist: new user moves every product type from the wishlist to the cart
web_commons.story: FALCONS-316 - Move products from the wishlist to the cart
web_commons.docstring: 1. Register a brand-new user, whose wishlist and cart both start empty 2. Add every product type to the wishlist from its PDP 3. Move each wishlist item to the cart, choosing a value when the options sheet opens 4. Verify every moved item leaves the wishlist and the cart holds one row per move 5. Verify the wishlist shows its empty state once the last item has moved
